definitions.explanation: Fitting or right for a particular situation, purpose, or context. Implies a well-considered choice that is neither too much nor too little.

examples.japanese: {適切|てきせつ}な{対応|たいおう}をお{願|ねが}いします。
{状況|じょうきょう}に{適切|てきせつ}な{判断|はんだん}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: Making an appropriate judgment for the situation is required.

examples.japanese: {適切|てきせつ}な{時期|じき}に{適切|てきせつ}な{治療|ちりょう}を{受|う}ければ、{回復|かいふく}の{可能性|かのうせい}は{高|たか}い。
examples.english: If you receive proper treatment at the right time, the chances of recovery are high.

notes:
A formal and versatile na-adjective used across many contexts — business, medicine, education, law, and daily life. It implies that the choice or action is well-matched to the situation at hand. Often used in written language and formal speech.

The adverbial form {適切|てきせつ}に (appropriately) is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適切|てきせつ}な{対応|たいおう}: appropriate response
- {適切|てきせつ}な{判断|はんだん}: proper judgment
- {適切|てきせつ}な{表現|ひょうげん}: appropriate expression
- {適切|てきせつ}な{処置|しょち}: proper treatment/measures
- {適切|てきせつ}な{時期|じき}: the right time
- {適切|てきせつ}に{対処|たいしょ}する: to deal with appropriately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {適当|てきとう}な: suitable; appropriate — can also mean "random" or "half-hearted" in colloquial use, making it ambiguous
- {妥当|だとう}な: reasonable; valid — emphasizes logical soundness rather than fitness for purpose
- {相応|そうおう}しい: befitting; worthy of — emphasizes matching in status or level
- {的確|てきかく}な: precise; accurate — emphasizes hitting the mark exactly
